events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The ongoing conflict in Iran is escalating, with potential implications for global oil markets and geopolitical stability. The US and its allies are considering further military action, while Iran has threatened to retaliate. The situation remains highly volatile, with potential for significant price movements in oil and defense-related stocks.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war has significant implications for global oil markets, with potential for supply disruptions and price increases. This could lead to increased demand for defense-related stocks, as well as a safe-haven bid for gold and other precious metals.

timeFrame.note: Monitor news and market developments closely

events.exitStrategy: Exit positions if a ceasefire is announced or if oil prices drop below $60/bbl
